posts.name: Nihantra Patel
posts.cooked:
Hi @Kiranmai,

Please check the post.

Cloning and Installing remote repository changes into local system ERPNext
Hello @Kiranmai, To get any app, use the following command: bench get-app --branch git-branch git_app_path // Example bench get-app --branch version-15 https://github.com/frappe/erpnext.git For app installation on a specific site, use: bench --site your_sitename.com install-app erpnext To update the erpnext app, navigate to the app directory and execute: git pull upstream version-15 Ensure that you set the version as per the app requirements. Here are some references for your guidance: …

Thank You!

posts.name: Haris Hashim
posts.cooked:
Just to update what work for me.

  1. Manually delete the offending app folder from apps subfolder
  2. Delete the app name inside apps.txt in sites subfolder
  3. bench update --reset , bench setup requirements
  4. bench start
